sources.author: Epic Games
sources.title: Supporting Screen Readers
claims: Screen-reader support described for Windows third-party readers and iOS VoiceOver.
Accessible Behavior Auto uses assigned widget text, Custom uses developer-provided text, Summary concatenates child text.
Override Accessible Defaults exposes behavior settings; activation is required.
limits: No API member signature, automatic child-label resolution, platform-wide compatibility or execution claim.
Summary duplication is a proposed check, not an observed or guaranteed failure.

sources.author: Microsoft
sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 106: Screen narration
sources.location: How should an item be narrated?
sources.claim: A visible control label should be available as the corresponding narrated label; names, roles and applicable state/value remain distinct concerns.
limits: Guidance is not platform certification or implementation verification.
No requirement to normalize dialect or intentional spelling is inferred.

original_example.setup: The existing hypothetical subtitle-settings flow changes its visible button from 取消 to 继续调整. A hypothetical Custom narration input remains old.
checks: Identify focused widget and selected mode.
Trace visible and narrated text sources through current language/content.
Inspect child aggregation only if Summary is selected.
Actually operate/listen on the target platform before claiming a result.
original_example.execution: Unexecuted design/checking example; no engine, screen reader, audio or human test.

rejected_scope: No support for a general rule that intentional character spelling should be replaced with standard-language narration. Separate semantics and platform behavior require their own evidence.
